gen_risks.description: Armed conflict, civil unrest, and socio-political instability in participating countries could disrupt project execution and health service delivery.
gen_risks.mitigation: Adopt flexible implementation strategies tailored to FCV areas, conduct Security Risk Assessments, and establish Security Risk Management Plans.
gen_risks.evidence: Political instability, particularly in the North-West and South-West regions, may disrupt service delivery

gen_risks.description: Extreme climate shocks, such as severe flooding and droughts, risk damaging health infrastructure and driving outbreaks of waterborne and vector-borne diseases.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate green, resilient design standards for health infrastructure and integrate climate shock alerts into digital health surveillance systems.
gen_risks.evidence: More frequent flooding events in CAR and Chad drive recurrent cholera outbreaks and other waterborne diseases

gen_risks.description: Macroeconomic instability, constrained fiscal space, and declining oil revenues in beneficiary countries pose risks to long-term domestic health security funding.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide technical assistance to integrate health security into Medium-Term Expenditure Frameworks and establish domestic health security budget tracking.
gen_risks.evidence: macroeconomic constraints pose challenges for the long-term sustainability of health investments.

gen_risks.description: Fiduciary weaknesses and decentralized project activities create risks of questionable expenditures and non-compliant financial management.
gen_risks.mitigation: Customize project accounting software, mandate internal/external audits within statutory deadlines, and update procedures manuals for local partners.
gen_risks.evidence: several activities under the project like workshops, trainings and the local-level capacity building are at risk to generate questionable expenditures

gen_risks.description: Limited market competition in fragile settings and weak contract management capacities could result in severe procurement delays and execution bottlenecks.
gen_risks.mitigation: Recruit qualified procurement specialists, utilize STEP tracking in real-time, engage suppliers early, and apply flexible FCV procurement frameworks.
gen_risks.evidence: Procurement Risks include delays, governance issues, weak contract management, and limited market competition in fragile settings.

gen_risks.description: Expanded laboratory operations and diagnostic testing generate chemical, biological, and medical waste that poses environmental and community safety hazards.
gen_risks.mitigation: Update and implement Healthcare and Biomedical Waste Management Plans with strict protocols for hazardous waste handling, treatment, and disposal.
gen_risks.evidence: laboratories will be supplied with reagents, chemicals, and equipment that may constitute medical waste once used.

gen_risks.description: Increased community health worker deployment and civil works generate risks of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse, Sexual Harassment, and Gender-Based Violence.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prepare country-specific SEA/SH Action Plans, recruit dedicated GBV specialists, train health workers, and establish GBV-sensitive grievance mechanisms.
gen_risks.evidence: The overall project SEA/SH risks are judged to be substantial.

gen_risks.description: Marginalized and vulnerable populations, including IDPs, refugees, and rural communities, face potential exclusion from project benefits and health communications.
gen_risks.mitigation: Adapt Stakeholder Engagement Plans to national contexts, implement inclusive risk communication strategies, and establish operational local Grievance Redress Mechanisms.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential social risks are substantial and relate to... the exclusion of vulnerable or disadvantaged groups

gen_risks.description: Insufficient multisectoral coordination across human, animal, and environmental health sectors risks delaying disease outbreak detection and containment.
gen_risks.mitigation: Operationalize subnational, national, and regional One Health coordination platforms and execute cross-border information-sharing agreements.
gen_risks.evidence: Central African countries struggle to prevent, detect, and respond to health emergencies due to... insufficient multisectoral coordination.

gen_risks.description: Gender disparities and societal barriers limit female health workers' access to advanced field epidemiology and veterinary epidemiology training programs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct targeted outreach for female health workers, establish gender targets in FETP/ISAVET programs, and offer flexible training formats.
gen_risks.evidence: In AFW, women dominate low-paid frontline roles but are largely absent from technical positions

gen_risks.description: Delays in recruiting and establishing fully staffed Project Implementation Units could derail initial project launch and activity schedules.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce strict legal covenant deadlines for key PIU specialist recruitment and utilize Project Preparation Advances where available.
gen_risks.evidence: The Recipient shall, not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, appoint, assign, or recruit an accountant... environmental specialist

gen_risks.description: Inadequate data security and privacy protocols during digital surveillance and cross-border data sharing could compromise sensitive health information.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish ethical data governance guidelines and data security protocols for digital surveillance systems in compliance with national laws and best practices.
gen_risks.evidence: inadequate attention to ensure that guidelines established under the Program include considerations for and ethical data security protocols

gen_risks.description: Civil works for laboratory construction and health facility rehabilitation may lead to involuntary land acquisition or land use restrictions.
gen_risks.mitigation: Perform environmental and social screening for all civil works, prepare site-specific Resettlement Plans as needed, and exclude physical displacement.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential social risks are substantial and relate to... land acquisition impacts associated with new constructions

gen_risks.description: Public health emergencies threaten to overwhelm health facilities and divert resources away from routine primary care and maternal and child services.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop essential health service contingency plans, deploy epidemic-ready primary health care networks, and routinely monitor service delivery metrics.
gen_risks.evidence: Prior epidemics show that future health emergencies could further strain health systems... disrupt services like maternal and child health

gt_risks.description: Political and governance risk (Moderate), considering fragility, socio-political instability, violence and weak governance of beneficiary countries.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close engagement by the World Bank to coordinate activities with other key partners.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk (Substantial), considering the complexities of coordinating national-level and regional-level activities to align and build on each other, and the different levels of readiness at country-level.
gt_risks.mitigation: Exploring the possibility of a coordinated implementation arrangement with CEMAC as the lead technical coordination body for regional activities.

gt_risks.description: Weak institutional capacity for implementation and sustainability (Substantial), combined with overstretched or nonexistent PIUs in respective countries.
gt_risks.mitigation: Strengthening the existing PIUs and intensive capacity building and targeted TA for newly established PIUs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risk (Substantial) due to weak governance structures and inadequate FM systems.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on fiduciary processes.

gt_risks.description: E&S risk (Substantial) given the security risks associated with service delivery in FCV (fragility, conflict, and violence) settings.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on managing E&S risks.
